title: A Multi-Agent Pipeline for Robust Machine Learning Benchmarking

contributions.purpose: 提出模块化多智能体ML基准测试流水线
contributions.mechanism: 把预处理/训练/评估/聚合分别封装为自主 agent,实现故障隔离与并行
contributions.source_quote: We propose a modular multi-agent pipeline for comparative machine learning, in which autonomous agents handle preprocessing, training, evaluation, and results aggregation.

contributions.mechanism: 维度不匹配时逐级回退(permutation importance→模型系数/feature_importances_→跳过但仍记指标)
contributions.evaluation: 定性:声称避免了 baseline 脚本在 20 Newsgroups 上的崩溃
contributions.source_quote: A key innovation is our "safe aggregation" mechanism, which prevents runtime crashes by gracefully handling incompatible dimensionalities.

contributions.mechanism: Iris/Wine/Breast Cancer/Digits/20 Newsgroups 上跑 LogReg/RF/GradBoost
contributions.evaluation: Iris RF 0.96/F1 0.95,Wine RF 0.98,Breast Cancer GB 0.97,20NG RF 0.61/GB 0.63;结论 ensemble>linear
contributions.source_quote: Results show that ensemble models consistently outperform linear baselines, while safe aggregation ensures reliability across tasks.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Large-scale benchmarking frameworks such as OpenML and AutoML systems have standardized evaluation pipelines, but they remain largely monolithic. Our pipeline differs by delegating tasks to agents with explicit responsibilities.

notes: desk-reject。学生课程作业级低质,篇幅极短,作者署名为"AI"。自声明贡献4条(架构/safe aggregation/5数据集实证/可视化),归并为 C1-C3。数据红旗/不一致:Methodology 声称对回归任务(California Housing)报 MSE 和 R²,但 Results 只有分类结果,回归为悬空未做——方法与结果不一致(疑似 AI 生成模板遗留)。trade-off:Limitations 自认仅经典ML+中小数据集、safe aggregation 完全失败时会低报指标。checklist AI 披露:Experimental design/Writing/Editing/Figures 为"Mostly human assisted by AI",Hypothesis/Analysis 为 Human-generated;AI(ChatGPT)写代码与 LaTeX,safe aggregation 逻辑由 AI 建议。
